name: Collaboration Channels
limitations: Channel identity may be swept before selection, but participant profiles may be read only for exact operator-selected conversation identities.
A provider participant never becomes a CRM person automatically; only exact email or unique exact-name resolution may produce a personUri.
Only exact existing organization records may be related; missing organizations become review residue and are never created implicitly.
Every exact channel create or update remains separately approval-, one-time-start-, checkpoint-, and verification-bound.
Message content is outside channel ingestion and remains private untrusted data owned by a separate review workflow.
